newsitem.title: JAPAN: Taka-Q,Esprit venture seen posting 3 bln yen sales.
newsitem.headline: Taka-Q,Esprit venture seen posting 3 bln yen sales.

text.p: A joint venture between Taka-Q Co Ltd and the Bermuda-based holding company of Esprit Asia Holdings Ltd is expected to post annual sales of three billion yen in its initial year of operation, Taka-Q said on Monday.
Taka-Q, a Japanese maker of menswear, said earlier that the 50-50 venture would be set up in July to operate shops in Japan.

The venture will sell men's, women's and children's apparel, with annual sales in the first business year forecast at three billion yen, increasing to six billion yen by the end of the second year and reaching 10 billion yen by the end of the third year, Taka-Q said in the statement.
The venture will have 30 outlets in Japan in the first year of its business, rising to 60 outlets by the end of the second year and 100 outlets by the end of the third year, Taka-Q said.
Taka-Q's group earnings forecast for the year to February 28, 1998, which was unveiled in May, remains unchanged despite the planned venture, the statement said.
In May, Taka-Q said it would post a group net loss of 930 million yen in 1997/98 against its actual group net loss of 692 million yen in the previous year.
On Monday, Taka-Q's shares closed at 340 yen, up by 29 yen, in reaction to news of the planned joint venture.
